principal_dawn_visual_assessment_status: COMPLETED. The first after-dawn owner burst at 06:10–06:14 CDT had limited Point Clear detectability, so the principal call uses the first published dawn+20 follow-up at 06:31–06:34 CDT. All six cameras were healthy with valid three-frame bursts; five had moderate and montrose_pier_bird high detectability; no Jubilee, searching, flashlight or collecting signal was resolved. Post-dawn public live-player checks at 06:36–06:37 CDT were probably fresh and yielded scoped no-event evidence in their visible areas.

change_summary: Fresh NGOFS2 15Z forward guidance changed from approximately −6/+78/+199/+295 m to +30/+16/−41/+173 m at 1/3/6/12 hours. The one-hour window turned modestly shoreward, but three-hour delivery weakened sharply and the six-hour window reversed to seaward; twelve-hour guidance remains shoreward. All six owner cameras were healthy at 16:06–16:09 CDT with moderate-to-high detectability and no scoped Jubilee signal. Both validated public players advanced across isolated 32.178-second samples at 16:51–16:52 CDT; strong glare limited biological assessment and no material biological or human-response signal appeared.
